name: agent-sandbox
postCreateCommand: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && npm i -g opencode-ai
_why: Permissions in opencode.json are a policy boundary. This is the isolation boundary. Run any unattended or --auto session in here, never on the host. Note the API key is still visible to processes inside the container: use a scoped, low-limit key for agent work.
